name: AuxPair.FitsParams.exists_isJointHarmonic
summary: At each place the staircase polynomial built from the column numbers is a highest joint harmonic with staircase weights (S); joint harmonics for matched parameters exist and are unique up to scalar, which identifies the lowest K-type of -l with the staircase weight (J); and harmonicPoly at the highest vector is, after unfolding, the product over the places of these staircases.

steps.claim: From FitsParams(O, l): p, the matching of paramV(O, w, .) and -l(w) at every w, and o, the description of ord(O); and t: paramV(O, ., .) is a Harish-Chandra parameter (isHCParam_paramV).
For each place w choose a bijection f_w of n with {0, ..., |n| - 1} listing the indices by decreasing paramV(O, w, .).

The three statements follow from S (for every w, the staircase polynomial is a highest joint harmonic with staircase weights) and J (the lowest K-types of -l(w) are the staircase weights), proved in 3.4 and 3.5.
steps.lean:
exact (fun S ↦ (fun J ↦ ⟨_, fun w ↦ ⟨p w, funext (J w) ▸ S w⟩, by
    simp [*, ← (hcParameter_strictAnti.injective <| u _ _ ▸ t.eq_hcParameter · ·), harmonicPoly,
      highestVector, MixedCartanEmbedding.top]
    simp [letterPoly, weylKernel, highestPoly, permArray, Matrix.map, tableauPoly, minor,
      AlgHom.map_det, rowSubst, ite_and, fockLetters, apply_ite, sum_filter], J⟩) fun w a ↦
    (p w).exists_isJointHarmonic.elim fun _ J ↦ by
    rw [← @Int.cast_inj ℂ, ← smul_left_inj J.2.1, ← J.2.2.1.1, (J.unique J.2.isPreJointHarmonic
      (S w).isPreJointHarmonic).choose_spec, map_smul, (S w).2.1.1, smul_comm]) fun w ↦
    staircase_harmonic_highest (p w).2.1 (t w).1 (o w) _ (by fin_cases · <;> tauto) (by grind
    [O.rank_lt, negCount, neg_units_ne_self, by simpa using card_congr (.sigmaFiberEquiv O.signs)])
    (by simp [subtype_card, Int.units_ne_iff_eq_neg, vacuumWeight, detExp, sum_Ico_reflect,
    diagramWeight_apply, ← Ico_succ_left_eq_Ioo, t.lowestKType_eq]; grind [sum_Ico_eq_sub])

steps.claim: Take Phi(w) the staircase polynomial of S at w; it is a joint harmonic for the matching p(w), with the weights identified by J.
steps.lean: ⟨_, fun w ↦ ⟨p w, funext (J w) ▸ S w⟩,

steps.claim: harmonicPoly(O)(highestVector(kappa(O), paramV(O, ., .))) is the product over w of the renamed Phi(w): unfold harmonicPoly, the highest vector (a permutation array, its position given by the strictly decreasing Harish-Chandra parameter), the letter polynomials and the tableau polynomial as a product of minors.

by

      highestVector, MixedCartanEmbedding.top]
    simp [letterPoly, weylKernel, highestPoly, permArray, Matrix.map, tableauPoly, minor,

steps.claim: J: for each w and index a, the lowest K-type of -l(w) at a equals the weight of S at a: a joint harmonic for the matching p(w) exists (exists_isJointHarmonic); joint harmonics are unique up to a nonzero scalar, so it is a multiple of the staircase of S(w), and the weights agree.
steps.lean:
fun w a ↦
    (p w).exists_isJointHarmonic.elim fun _ J ↦ by
    rw [← @Int.cast_inj ℂ, ← smul_left_inj J.2.1, ← J.2.2.1.1, (J.unique J.2.isPreJointHarmonic
      (S w).isPreJointHarmonic).choose_spec, map_smul, (S w).2.1.1, smul_comm])

steps.claim: S: for each w, staircase_harmonic_highest applies: the parameters match (p w), paramV(O, w, .) is a Harish-Chandra parameter (t w), ord(O) is the signed ordering of FitsParams (o w): among the indices with the same sign, ord(O) numbers them by decreasing s(c) l(w, c), that is by decreasing l(w, c) at the sign +1 and by increasing l(w, c) at the sign -1; the numbers of signs fit (rank_lt, negCount), and the weights agree (vacuumWeight, detExp).
steps.lean:

    (by simp [subtype_card, Int.units_ne_iff_eq_neg, vacuumWeight, detExp, sum_Ico_reflect,
    diagramWeight_apply, ← Ico_succ_left_eq_Ioo, t.lowestKType_eq]; grind [sum_Ico_eq_sub])
